description: XOPPUP crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: (C19 H16 Ce1 N5 O6)n. From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 7 O neighbors; Ce1_2 (Ce) has 3 O neighbors; Ce1_3 (Ce) has 1 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.269-4.269 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 107.41-107.41°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ce(ccnm)(OAc)2(phen)]n. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
